### [126] [CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08777)
*Shangye Song,Dong Gong,Hong Jia,Yun Sing Koh,Xinyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CtrlCache，一种免训练、控制感知的缓存框架，依据控制信号提前规划扩散步计算，减少交互视频世界模型的去噪开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效分块自回归生成并忠实响应用户控制，但每块仍需多次昂贵去噪迭代。现有免训练缓存策略主要依据模型内部去噪动态做复用决策，未显式考虑控制切换，而控制信号已在去噪前到达，可零前向开销地用于调度。

Method: 分析不同控制状态下相邻块的结构相似性变化：动作切换处结构相似性下降，低频结构比高频细节更持久。据此设计动作感知调度与刷新策略，跨块和块内检测动作变化，将块标记为初始、过渡、转向、稳态四类；在选定内部去噪步，初始与过渡块保留完整计算，转向与稳态块复用同块内最近完整计算步的Transformer残差。并引入频率混合历史先验引导，在不增加DiT前向的情况下融入前一干净潜变量的互补信息。

Result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0与LingBot-World v1/v2上，CtrlCache在免重训练下实现DiT骨干1.21x至1.41x加速，且三模型WBench Overall分数均优于原始推理。

Conclusion: 显式利用控制信号进行缓存调度可同时提升交互视频生成的效率与质量，且无需训练或额外前向开销。

Abstract: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

</details>


### [127] [ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08779)
*Zhenghong Zhou,Zhe Lin,Jiebo Luo,Yuqian Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ALIVE是一个视频编辑框架，通过搭配3D渲染、模型生成和真实世界数据，使插入物体能与源视频内容产生连贯交互（如被拾取、操纵），无需额外用户输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑器虽能插入物体，但难以让插入物体参与交互（如被拾取或操纵），缺乏与源视频内容的连贯互动。

Method: 1) 构建35,800对编辑样本，融合3D渲染、模型生成及真实世界视频与ROSE通用编辑对，样本在目标物体存在性上不同但保持周围动作一致；2) 训练视觉语言模型（VLM）从相同输入预测交互引导；3) 提出ALIVE-interaction基准，用统一VLM协议评估交互保真度、源保真度与视觉连贯性。

Result: 在无VLM引导下，ALIVE在两个基准上的Overall指标分别超过最强基线43.9%和4.4%；VLM预测引导可进一步提升ALIVE-interaction得分0.95分，且无需额外用户输入。

Conclusion: ALIVE通过数据构建与VLM引导，实现了插入物体与源视频的连贯交互，在交互保真度、源保真度和视觉连贯性上均优于基线，拓展了视频物体插入的任务能力。

Abstract: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

</details>


### [128] [4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08782)
*Shiqi Li,Sean Cho,Yijie Li,Fengzhi Guo,Bowen Wen,Cheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 4D-HOF是一个前馈式4D手-物交互重建框架，利用条件流匹配将视觉基础模型得到的粗略手-物状态传输到交互流形，并在传输过程中通过测试时引导融入物理约束与2D观测证据，实现稳定的4D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D手-物重建方法多依赖昂贵的逐序列优化；而生成式方法通常从随机噪声合成交互，导致交互预测不稳定。因此需要一种既能前馈高效推理、又能稳定准确重建4D手-物交互的方法。

Method: 提出条件流匹配模型，将从视觉基础模型获得的粗略手-物状态（含平移、旋转、对齐误差）传输至交互流形，以纠正错误并实现前馈重建。该生成式建模天然支持传输过程中的测试时引导：直接利用物理交互约束和观测到的2D证据对演化中的生成状态进行引导，将重建精化内嵌于生成过程，而非事后独立优化。此外在多样化数据集上训练以增强泛化能力。

Result: 在域外基准上，4D-HOF达到当前最优性能，产生更稳定、更准确的4D手-物重建，并能稳健泛化到具有挑战性的野外场景。

Conclusion: 将视觉基础模型的粗估计与条件流匹配生成相结合，并在传输过程中施加物理与2D证据引导，可有效实现前馈、稳定且泛化性强的4D手-物交互重建。

Abstract: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

</details>


### [129] [Building Rome from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08790)
*Jiraphon Yenphraphai,Fang Li,Tianshuo Xu,Depu Meng,Quentin Herau,Yihan Hu,Raymond A. Yeh,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进物体中心式3D生成器（如Trellis 2）的方法，使其能同时适用于室内外场景的单图三维场景生成，通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模以及合成约4000个室外场景，在几何精度和感知质量上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练3D物体生成器虽具备强形状先验，但主要针对固定规范体积中的孤立物体，且聚焦室内场景。由于室外场景的多样化3D数据非常有限，将其直接用于完整的室内外场景生成（包括相机未观测区域）存在困难。因此需要重新设计这类物体中心生成器以扩展到通用场景。

Method: 方法包含三个关键设计：(a) 将场景划分为随相机距离缩放的自适应分块——近处分块更小以保留细节，远处结构（如建筑）用大分块覆盖；(b) 通过提升图像特征并让模型感知自由空间、已观测表面和未观测区域，使生成器捕捉显式的2D-3D对应关系；(c) 合成约4000个室外场景以扩充训练数据，弥补现有场景数据集以室内为主的不足。

Result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++以及野外图像上的实验表明，该方法在室内和室外场景的几何精度与感知质量方面均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模和室外数据合成，可将物体中心式3D生成器的先验迁移到通用场景重建任务，实现室内外统一的单图场景生成。

Abstract: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

</details>


### [130] [World Models' Last Exam in Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08791)
*Mingju Gao,Qingle Liu,Yuzhao Peng,Xinjie Lin,Ziming Qin,Zheng Jiang,Wenyi Li,Calvin Xiao,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Qinhuai Na*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"世界模型的物理期末考"（World Models' Last Exam in Physics），一个基于测量的视频世界模型物理一致性评测基准，覆盖40项受控任务与六大物理领域，评测8个视频生成模型的1280段视频，最佳模型得分仅57.76/100。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理上不一致的序列，影响其在具身智能预测与规划中的可靠性；现有评测多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试则多局限于力学，缺乏跨物理域、可解释、可量化的评测手段。

Method: 构建包含40个受控任务的基准，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学、表面张力；每个任务提供初始图像、生成提示与预设物理判据，无需参考视频即可测试可观测物理关系；评测器由"任务可观测性筛查"与"任务特定定量物理测量"两部分组成，并辅以已知物理关系的合成视频验证测量模块效度。

Result: 在8个视频生成模型、共1280段视频上评测，发现物理不一致普遍存在且任务间差异明显，最佳模型总体得分57.76/100；测量模块在受控合成视频上得到效度证据；评测器在任务内排序与成对比较中与人类判断的一致性均高于直接使用视觉语言模型的基线。

Conclusion: 该基准以跨物理域覆盖、可测量证据支撑的评分及明确的测量局限，为诊断物理不一致、追踪视频世界模型物理一致性进展提供了可解释的依据。

Abstract: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [131] [Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06889)
*Arnau Bueno Tricas,Jose A. Rodríguez-Serrano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出零样本可视化（ZSV）任务，通过基准测试系统比较了嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计三类方法，发现基于下一词元概率的打分在实际权衡中表现最佳，并给出端到端ZSV基线构建指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户希望在文本语料库的视觉探索中用自然语言指定概念，并将文档映射到相应概念轴上。构建有实用价值的ZSV系统并非易事，需要在特征函数、高效实现权衡以及影响可视化质量的前后处理决策之间做出选择，因此需要系统评估不同方法与设计选择。

Method: 建立了一个ZSV基准，涵盖嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计等方法，在多个数据集和用例上从语义忠实性、分数保真度和计算成本三个维度评估不同打分方法与设计选择，并将最优方法应用于无标注语料以考察真实探索场景下的行为。

Result: 基于下一词元概率的打分在所评估方法中提供了最强的实际权衡；在无标注语料实验中还发现应结合分级轴与二元相关性过滤，并揭示了离题文档中存在组合式情感偏差。

Conclusion: 基于这些发现，本文为构建端到端ZSV基线提供了实用指南。

Abstract: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

</details>


### [132] [Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06897)
*Or Shafran,Mor Geva*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将激活空间中的因果影响分解为容量、响应性和对齐三个因子，发现在50个概念、4个模型族上三者共同决定结构是否可操作，且因果有效性是上下文依赖的；据此提出将线性探针训练限制在因果子空间中的"因果探针"，在引导任务上提升17%-118%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定位语言模型激活空间中的潜在结构对理解与控制模型行为至关重要，但不同局部结构的因果影响力差异很大。核心问题是：什么样的结构是"可操作的"（actionable）？作者希望给出因果影响的因子化解释，并揭示因果性是否为结构的固有属性。

Method: 将因果影响建模为三个因子的乘积：capacity（容量，衡量输出对沿该结构移动的敏感度）、responsiveness（响应性，衡量在给定上下文中该概念的可提升程度）、alignment（对齐度，衡量结构与该概念上下文特定表示的一致程度）。在4个LM家族、50个概念上进行实证验证，并分析因果方向在不同上下文下的子空间结构；随后将线性探针的训练限制在该因果子空间中，得到"因果探针"（causal probes）。

Result: 因果有效性要求三个因子同时较高：低容量与低响应性分别使因果效果下降84%和95%，而低对齐度可使因果性反转、抑制概念表达。因果性并非结构的内在属性，而是上下文依赖的，因果有效的方向构成随上下文变化的低维子空间。基于该子空间训练的因果探针在跨模型引导任务中提升17%-118%，概念检测仅下降3%。

Conclusion: 因果影响可被分解为容量、响应性、对齐三个可解释且相互独立的约束；结构的因果有效性是上下文依赖的，有效方向位于变化的低维子空间。利用这一性质可显著提升引导性能而几乎不损失检测能力，为可解释性与模型控制提供了新的分析框架与工具。

Abstract: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.

</details>


### [133] [Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06902)
*Priyank Jayraj,Poonam Goyal,Navneet Goyal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NavTree 用确定性平衡段树作为纯导航支架，仅输出叶子块，在长文档 QA 中取得与最优平铺检索相当、优于 RAPTOR 类层次检索的效果，且索引零语言模型调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平铺 top-k 检索在长文档上易聚集于单一区域而遗漏互补证据；RAPTOR 类摘要树虽可缓解，但需在索引期递归聚类并调用语言模型生成摘要，成本高。作者质疑该收益是否真来自生成的摘要内容。

Method: 提出 NavTree：仅含叶子的检索器，在块上构建确定性平衡段树，索引期零语言模型调用；将树纯粹用作导航支架，采用词汇与稠密混合的前沿游走，以 top 检索叶子为锚点自根下行，最终只向读者输出叶子块。

Result: 在等成本评估中，NavTree 是所评网格内最强的等成本层次检索器，并追平最强平铺基线；在长文档多跳 QA 上，是唯一在类对类比较中显著优于 BM25 的层次方法，并由无阅读器检索召回检验佐证。对已发表抽象式 RAPTOR 变体的等阅读器复现（即使给定强聚类摘要）在每个多块预算下仍不及 NavTree，且后者索引成本为零。该排序在更强及开放权重阅读器、更强编码器与全因子实验中保持稳健，并隔离出"仅输出叶子"这一结构性杠杆。

Conclusion: 摘要树在长文档 QA 中的主要收益来自导航作用，而非生成的摘要内容；仅用树做导航、零索引语言模型成本即可获得更好且更稳健的检索效果。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementation of RAPTOR, NavTree is the strongest matched-cost hierarchical retriever in our evaluated grid and ties the strongest flat baseline. On long-document multi-hop QA, it is the only hierarchical method that significantly beats BM25 on a class-vs-class basis, corroborated by a reader-free retrieval-recall check. A matched-reader replication of the published abstractive RAPTOR variant, given strong cluster summaries, still loses to NavTree at every multi-chunk budget, at zero indexing cost. The ranking carries across stronger and open-weight readers, a stronger encoder, and a full factorial that isolates leaves-only emission as the structural lever.

</details>


### [134] [Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06903)
*Vincent Siu,Glenn Grant-Richards,Vlad Pavlovich,Yizhou Sun,Dawn Song,Chenguang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对拒绝行为的激活操控进行组件级分解，发现拒绝方向集中于稀疏的注意力与MLP组件及稀疏的残差流维度，呈现双层稀疏结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活操控（activation steering）能改变大语言模型行为，但其干预的机制基础尚不清楚，尤其拒绝行为的内部表征结构缺乏机械可解释性层面的刻画。

Method: 在四个开放权重模型上，将拒绝操控分解为组件级干预；识别足以复现完整行为效果的稀疏注意力与MLP组件子集，并在这些机制内进一步定位承载信号的残差流维度子集，形成组件层与维度层的两级稀疏分析。

Result: 拒绝方向集中在占上游组件28%–48%的稀疏组件机制中，仍保留88%–101%的操控有效性；在这些机制内，有效操控进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留85%–98%的组件机制基线表现，符合privileged basis结构假设。

Conclusion: 拒绝并非弥散编码于整个Transformer，而是由结构化、可识别的稀疏机制组装而成；稀疏性体现在被操控的组件与组件内承载信号的维度两个层面，为理解拒绝行为的表征与操控提供了机制基础，并公开代码与原始实验数据以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.

</details>


### [135] [Stabilizing language models under continual learning via condition-anchored distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06940)
*Huan Li,Zhe Cao,Qinlei Xie,Fushun Cui,Xuechen Liang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出条件锚定生成式蒸馏（CAGD），通过保留少量旧提示、用冻结旧模型重建生成状态并匹配其预测分布，在持续适配中实现功能保持，并在掩码扩散与自回归模型上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型持续适配会改变旧提示上的输出分布，而保留全部旧提示-答案对既不现实也不理想，因此需要一种更高效的旧行为保持机制。

Method: CAGD保留少量旧提示作为条件来选择需保护的行为，用冻结的上一模型重建补全与生成状态作为定位，并以软目标规定预测可变化的方式。自回归生成中采用教师滚动蒸馏的链式法则精确分解序列散度；掩码扩散建模中则直接控制教师生成补全上的局部去噪漂移。

Result: 在219M掩码扩散模型的四任务持续适配中，最终留出损失从2.927降至1.114（一任务顺序）、从2.168降至0.891（完全逆序）；在教师生成支持相同时，软目标比硬回放平均损失低0.055。方向性在SMDM、Qwen3的新事实与自然指令上持续存在；GSM8K上Qwen保持答案格式合规，但精确匹配保持性在0.6B为种子混合、1.7B变差。

Conclusion: 结果表明，条件锚定的功能保持可作为所测语言生成目标中通用的设计原则。

Abstract: Continual adaptation of language models can change their output distribution on prompts learned earlier, while retaining every old prompt-answer pair may be undesirable or impossible. We study condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD): retain a small set of old prompts, use a frozen previous model to reconstruct completions and generation states, and match its predictive distributions while learning the next task. The formulation separates three roles that ordinary replay conflates: conditions select the behavior to protect, teacher generations locate relevant states, and soft targets specify how predictions may change. For autoregressive language generation, teacher-rollout distillation admits an exact chain-rule decomposition of sequence divergence. For masked-diffusion language modeling, our implementation directly controls local denoising drift on teacher-generated completions. In continual adaptation of a 219M masked diffusion language model, CAGD reduces four-task final held-out loss from 2.927 to 1.114 in one task order and from 2.168 to 0.891 in exact reverse. The same soft targets lower final average loss by 0.055 over hard replay when teacher-generated support is held identical. The direction persists on fresh facts and natural instructions across SMDM and Qwen3. On GSM8K, Qwen adaptation preserves answer-format compliance, but exact-match retention is seed-mixed at 0.6B and worsens at 1.7B. These results support condition-anchored functional preservation as a common design principle across the tested language-generation objectives.

</details>


### [136] [EMODE: Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts for Emotion-Aware Speech Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06956)
*Jianan Pan,Yiwen Gu,Xinze Li,Rui Wang,Kejie Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EMODE：基于动态副语义专家的情感感知语音语言模型，通过语义-副语言分解实现情感理解与生成的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型语音语言模型虽具备跨模态理解与生成能力，但副语言线索（尤其情感）难以保留。已有的系统依赖纠缠的声学表征，导致底层语言模型过度依赖恢复出的词汇内容，而非基于声学-韵律证据进行行为决策。

Method: 提出EMODE情感感知语音语言模型，核心为动态副语义专家（DPSE）：将连续语音特征分解为语义与副语言两条通路，动态路由并在融入语言模型前进行融合。为将结构分解转化为功能专精，采用三阶段课程训练：语义预热、副语言激活、联合精调，并辅以正交专家引导（OEG）、语义到声学对齐（SAA）与门控多样性正则（GDR）。

Result: 在语音情感识别（SER）测试、共情响应评估以及新构建的双语MEPA基准上，EMODE改善了词汇保真度与情感敏感度之间的平衡，增强了基于情感响应的生成能力，并揭示了显式副语义因子分解对鲁棒跨语料情感理解的价值。

Conclusion: EMODE通过显式副语义因子分解与课程化训练，有效缓解了声学表征纠缠问题，在情感理解与生成任务上取得更优的词汇-情感平衡，验证了副语义分解在跨语料情感建模中的有效性。

Abstract: Large speech language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in unified cross-modal understanding and generation, yet paralinguistic cues, especially emotion, remain difficult to preserve. Existing systems typically rely on entangled acoustic representations, which allow the underlying language model to depend excessively on recovered lexical content instead of grounding its behavior in acoustic-prosodic evidence. We address this limitation with EMODE, an emotion-aware speech language model built around \textbf{Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts (DPSE)}. DPSE decomposes continuous speech features into semantic and paralinguistic pathways, routes them dynamically, and fuses them before integration into the language model. To turn this structural decomposition into functional specialization, EMODE is trained with a three-stage curriculum consisting of semantic warm-up, paralinguistic activation, and joint refinement, guided by Orthogonal Expert Guidance (OEG), Semantic-to-Acoustic Alignment (SAA), and Gating Diversity Regularization (GDR). Experiments on SER test, empathetic response evaluation, and the newly constructed bilingual MEPA benchmark show that EMODE improves the balance between lexical fidelity and emotional sensitivity, strengthens affect-grounded response generation, and exposes the value of explicit para-semantic factorization for robust cross-corpus emotion understanding.

</details>


### [137] [Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06962)
*Nishanth Nayakanti,Prasang Gupta,Ashutosh Bilthare,Kevin Paul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在仅有裁决结果（verdict）而无人工证据标注的审核场景下，测试小型语言模型能否恢复支撑证据。仅在裁决上做标签训练可达准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样方法为0.797和0.556，均优于训练前的0.747和0.493。逐字引用率分别提升至0.729与0.701。准确率与证据质量相关性弱，无法相互替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多审核流程只保留最终裁决，背后的证据段落未被标注，因为标注证据的成本远高于记录决策本身。作者希望探究：在完全没有人工证据标签的情况下，仅用裁决结果对小型模型进行后训练，能恢复多少证据。

Method: 在ContractNLI数据集上，将人工证据跨度保留至评测阶段。采用两种无需证据标注的训练方式：一是仅用裁决标签训练（label-only training）；二是拒绝采样（rejection sampling），即仅当生成轨迹的裁决与记录一致时保留该轨迹，再用自动来源接地（source-grounding）分数挑选其一。

Result: 六种系统中，匹配裁决与匹配证据跨度得分仅弱相关且排名不一致，说明准确率并不能反映引用可复核性。标签训练达准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样为0.797和0.556，训练前基线为0.747和0.493。逐字引用率在标签训练下由0.597升至0.729，在拒绝采样下达0.701。

Conclusion: 单一种子、单一语料不足以判定两种方法孰优孰劣，但二者都能在无人标注证据的前提下改善证据质量；同时提示裁决准确率与证据可复核性是两个不同的评价维度。

Abstract: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

</details>


### [138] [WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06963)
*Guancheng Du,Luotian Huang,Shaowen Wang,Si Li,Kaifeng Lyu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: WavePrune 将 RoPE 的每个通道限制在首个旋转周期内，消除了位置混叠，提升长上下文性能，并在 32K 上下文下实现显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoPE 通过以通道特定频率旋转 query 和 key 向量的二维通道来编码位置，使注意力 logits 对位置的整体平移保持不变。但旋转具有周期性，导致相对位置相差一个完整旋转周期时难以区分，产生位置混叠（position aliasing），在注意力图中引入干扰，损害长上下文表现。

Method: 提出 WavePrune：将每个通道限制在其首个旋转周期内（即滑动窗口），从而消除由位置混叠造成的注意力图干扰。同时设计了与硬件对齐的 CUDA kernel，利用由此产生的细粒度稀疏性加速计算。

Result: 在五个测试模型中的四个上无需额外调优即提升 HELMET 分数（如 Qwen3-8B 从 35.7 提升至 40.0）。从零预训练时，WavePrune 在外推长度上获得更低的验证损失。在 32K 上下文下，相比 FlashAttention-2 实现 1.15 倍 prefill 和 1.24 倍解码加速。

Conclusion: 结果表明，RoPE 被广泛认为必不可少的周期性结构，在首个旋转周期之外基本是冗余的。

Abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

</details>


### [139] [Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07019)
*Johann Emmanuel Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开源模型，对临床试验文章回答干预措施相对比较组对结局的影响方向，并给出概率；在 Evidence Inference 2.0 测试集上四项预注册标准全部通过，且对输入扰动显示出可解释的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将随机对照试验文章中"干预是否显著增加、降低或未显著改变某结局"的判定自动化，需要输出概率且校准良好、可复现、合规可发布的小型专用模型。

Method: 以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为底座，加入低秩适配器与决策头，仅用 2,657 篇训练文章中 1,431 篇许可允许复用的文章进行 EI 专用微调；输入截断至 6,144 tokens。预先在 Open Science Framework 注册四项标准，以 EI 公开标注的测试集预测结果决定是否发布，并做无文章、仅标题、互换干预与比较组等扰动实验。

Result: 测试集（333 篇文章、1,218 个提示）上期望校准误差 0.0168（上限 0.05）；对数损失比先验低 0.8603（95% 区间 0.8104–0.9078），比读同样输入的 Gemma 4 31B-it 低 0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；宏平均 F1 为 0.9248（对照 0.8668），四项标准全部通过。仅用干净文章训练使准确率下降 0.0123（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）。无文章时宏平均 F1 降至 0.4384；仅给标题提升 0.0939（0.0655–0.1234）；互换干预与比较组后 0.6652 的方向性答案发生反转。

Conclusion: 按发布版本运行所得文件与评估预测在预先设定的限度内一致，模型以 Apache License 2.0 发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722），可复现、校准良好，且其预测依赖具体输入内容而非标题线索。

Abstract: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

</details>


### [140] [Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07032)
*Maria Zafar,Souhail Bakkali,Rejwanul Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究结合知识蒸馏与量化技术压缩翻译模型，在法英生物医学翻译任务上实现模型体积减少69%、推理速度提升98.21%、CO2排放降低98.46%，且翻译质量不下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练Transformer模型在多语言机器翻译中表现优异，但部署成本高。知识蒸馏与量化是常见的模型压缩手段，然而在专业领域、低资源条件下，二者均存在局限：蒸馏受限于领域平行语料稀缺，量化则随比特精度下降导致性能退化。

Method: 针对法英生物医学翻译这一术语专业、平行资源有限的任务，作者联合应用知识蒸馏与量化，设计并比较了多种微调策略，以将压缩后的学生模型适配到该领域场景。

Result: 协同蒸馏并量化的学生模型相较原始基线，模型体积减少69%，推理速度提升98.21%，CO2排放降低98.46%，同时翻译质量未出现下降。

Conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术可产出高效、高性能的模型，适合资源受限条件下的翻译服务提供商使用，为低资源专业领域翻译的可持续部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

</details>


### [141] [Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07070)
*Aaron Fainman,Gabriela Kadlecová,Maciej Gryka,Bartosz Kruszczyński,Usman Zafar,Cédric Archambeau,Aaron Klein,David Salinas,Selim Nowicki,Jacek Golebiowski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种全自动轻量级合成框架，将每个API建模为有限状态机（FSM），以抽象状态约束工具调用时机，生成状态合法的工具序列，并用单次LLM调用将其扩展为完整对话样本，从而低成本地生成多轮工具调用微调数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型语言模型（SLM）部署成本低、可运行于私有基础设施，但基座模型在多轮工具调用上表现不足，而微调又缺乏各API的真实数据。现有合成方法需要针对不同领域构建模拟运行环境，且每生成一轮对话需多次调用LLM，成本过高，难以支撑大规模微调。

Method: 将每个API抽象为有限状态机，用抽象状态刻画系统，以确定每个工具何时可被调用，从而生成状态合法的工具调用序列；再通过单次LLM调用把工具序列翻译为完整训练样本。方法不追求多样性优化，而是对对话轮数、工具序列和任务复杂度设定目标分布来控制生成数据的构成。

Result: 通过在生成轨迹上微调SLM来评估数据质量。结果显示，基于FSM的生成相较未突变的基线显著提升下游准确率；与现有方法相比，完整准确率达到70.7%（对比63.4%与53.7%），且token消耗减少3.6–6.6倍。

Conclusion: 以有限状态机为核心的全自动轻量级合成框架，能够在无需模拟环境和极少LLM调用的条件下生成高质量多轮工具调用数据，显著提升小模型的下游准确率并大幅降低合成成本，为高规模微调提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

</details>


### [142] [JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07109)
*Yiqi Liu,Joseph James,Yang Wang,Kun Zhao,Chenghao Xiao,Chenghua Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出JudgeMoE，一种轻量聚合器，利用缓存评分分布的不确定性信息，按样本自适应加权融合，在16个评测单元上相较最强单一LLM评判者平均提升0.0393。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判者给出评分后，标量压缩会丢失评分分布中的不确定性与分歧信息；同时评分范围选择在不同评判者-数据集设置下不稳定。

Method: 设计JudgeMoE轻量聚合器，为每个样本分配特定权重，对缓存的评判者评分分布进行加权融合后再计算最终分数；并开展评分协议研究，对比软评分与硬解码、不同评分范围的影响。

Result: 在原始10单元基准上，相较均匀对数池化，平均Spearman提升+0.079；将同一配置推广至6个额外单元后，在16个单元上相较最强局部单一评判者平均提升+0.0393，16个单元中12个为正差异，单侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=0.0091；基于验证集的分析表明最优聚合方法依赖任务与评判者池。

Conclusion: 保留评分分布信息并采用样本自适应加权融合可有效提升评判者聚合性能，但最优聚合策略并非普适，需视任务与评判者池而定。

Abstract: When an LLM judge scores an output, its score distribution retains uncertainty and disagreement information that is lost after scalar compression. We introduce JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that assigns example-specific weights to cached judge score distributions and fuses them before computing a final score. A protocol study shows that score-range choice is unstable across judge--dataset settings and that soft scoring usually outperforms hard decoding. On the original 10-cell benchmark, JudgeMoE improves mean Spearman over uniform log pooling by $+0.079$. Applying the same configuration to six additional cells yields a $+0.0393$ mean gain over the strongest local single judge across 16 cells, with positive differences in 12/16 cells and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.0091$. Validation-based analyses further show that the preferred aggregation method depends on the task and judge pool.

</details>


### [143] [CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07132)
*Berke Arda,Ahmetcan Yavuz,Paul Gerry,Sebastian Lobentanzer,Nobin Sarwar,Joan Giner-Miguelez,Kongtao Chen,Luyao Zhang,Mrinmaya Sachan,Mubashara Akhtar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向 Croissant 元数据（含核心与 RAI 字段）的端到端抽取基准，含 602 篇论文，并系统评测多种抽取系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Croissant 已成为机器可读数据集元数据的事实标准，但其字段填充高度依赖人工、需细读数据集文档，且此前缺乏与社区标准 schema 对齐的端到端评测基准。

Method: 构建包含 602 篇论文的基准（102 篇人工验证金标注、500 篇 LLM 生成银标注），覆盖完整 Croissant schema（核心与 Responsible AI 字段）；采用规则评分与经人工审核选定的 LLM 评判器相结合的两层评测框架，评测量级覆盖前沿模型、开放权重模型及智能体式架构。

Result: 单次全文直抽取一致优于所评测的四种智能体式架构（各骨干下分解式变体准确率均更低）；最大差距出现在长篇幅 RAI 字段上——此类字段需整合散布于全文各处的信息而非单点复制，现有系统可靠性仍远未达标。

Conclusion: 元数据抽取中"分解成智能体"并非稳定增益，长文本、需综合推理的 RAI 字段是主要瓶颈；作者开放基准、评测代码、评判器审计、在线演示及排行榜以支持后续系统比较。

Abstract: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

</details>


### [144] [Identifying Introspection From the Inside](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07186)
*David I. Atkinson,Dillon Plunkett,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过低秩适配器训练模型隐式学习虚构角色的偏好，发现准确自我报告可自发涌现；其机制特征是偏好表征随训练向浅层迁移，且忠实模型的决策与自我报告任务具有更高的归因相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型对自身的陈述具有重要影响，但仅凭行为难以验证其真实性；需要区分合理的虚构性自我描述（confabulation）与真正的内省（introspection），因此需要寻找忠实自我报告的机制性标志。

Method: 使用低秩适配器（LoRA）让模型依据隐含的线性偏好函数为虚构角色做决策，并在无显式自我报告监督下观察自我报告的涌现；随后采用权重消融（weight ablations）、冻结层实验及归因修补（attribution patching）分析表征位置与任务间归因相似度。

Result: 持续微调后模型能准确自我报告其学到的偏好，即使无显式监督；权重消融与冻结层实验显示偏好表征随训练迁移至更早层；归因修补表明忠实模型在决策与自我报告任务间的归因相似度显著更高。

Conclusion: 在受限设定下，忠实自我报告要求偏好表征位于既有言语化机制可访问的层；通过分析网络结构本身（如归因相似度）可区分忠实与不忠实的自我报告计算模式，无需理解报告内容，为内省真实性验证提供了机制性判据。

Abstract: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

</details>


### [145] [TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07224)
*Jose D. Posada,Somalee Datta,Priya Desai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TIDE 2.0 是一个 MIT 许可的开源去标识化引擎，将识别器与密钥化匿名器解耦，通过密码学生成代理值、按患者位移日期并保持区间，实现可发布且跨发布不可链接的临床文本去标识化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床笔记是患者诊疗记录的主要载体，但含受保护健康信息（PHI），未去标识化前无法用于研究。现有做法常把去标识化仅当作检测问题，存在三类缺陷：脱敏会连同临床内容一起删除；日期置空破坏纵向分析所需的时间间隔；每次出现分配新的随机代理值会切断同一患者多份笔记之间的关联。此外，机构对数据外流与本地部署有合规和可控性需求。

Method: 提出 TIDE 2.0，采用两阶段可分离架构：可替换的识别器（recognizer）+ 密钥化匿名器（keyed anonymizer），均可部署在机构自有硬件上。代理值以密码学方式生成，不保存链接表；日期按患者施加保持间隔的偏移；在同一密钥下，同一取值在所有出现处共享同一代理值；使用新密钥生成的发布版本无法与早期版本关联。同时发布 TIDE2-Sentry，一个从大语言模型蒸馏得到的识别器。

Result: 在两个来自两家机构的金标准标注语料上，默认配置达到 span 级召回率：域内 0.88，第二家机构语料 0.77；精确率分别为 0.88 与 0.87。论文同时报告了各实体类别的召回率与精确率。

Conclusion: 识别与匿名化应被视为可分离的两阶段问题，而非单纯的检测任务。TIDE 2.0 通过密码学代理、保间隔日期位移和密钥隔离，在满足隐私要求的同时保留临床内容与纵向时间结构，并支持机构自托管。引擎开源，识别器通过受限研究使用协议提供，便于机构在自有环境中运行、审查与扩展。

Abstract: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

</details>


### [146] [Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07306)
*Matthew J. Vowels,Jamie Cummins*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Kurate 利用大语言模型（LLM）结合论文及其相关文档（如试验注册与方案），对已发表研究进行多维度质量评估，并将每项判断链接到支撑该判断的原文片段。应用于 4,347 篇论文（其中 3,913 篇为随机试验），在 8 个研究设计与报告维度上打分，与专家标注相比具有较高一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学检索系统能够找到与问题相关的论文，但通常不评估这些论文所提供证据的质量，这限制了大规模、系统性地判断研究证据可靠性。

Method: 提出 Kurate 系统：使用 LLM，同时利用论文正文与其相关文档（如试验注册、研究方案），对每篇论文在 8 个维度上评分，包括统计功效、因果识别、预注册、选择性报告、测量效度、分析预设定、报告透明性、利益冲突与资助；并将每项判断链接至对应文本段落。应用于 4,347 篇论文语料（3,913 篇报告随机试验）。

Result: 语料中最常见问题为统计功效、选择性报告和分析预设定，但不同临床领域的平均质量存在差异。与 60 份留出临床试验文档的专家标注对比，Kurate 提取信息在方案评分点中匹配 221/242，在结果发表评分点中匹配 294/370，AC1 分别为 0.94 和 0.81。以一个高质量临床试验为例，展示了单篇论文总体评级如何分解为多项判断，且每项判断均链接到注册、方案和发表报告中的具体证据。

Conclusion: 大规模研究质量评估是可行的，并可用于回答元科学（meta-scientific）研究问题。

Abstract: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

</details>


### [147] [Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07365)
*Zhuoyang Zou,Abolfazl Ansari,Jiaxi Yang,Delvin Ce Zhang,Qian Chen,Dongwon Lee,Wenpeng Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"洞见溯源"（Insight Provenance）任务，构建InsightProv-v0数据集，并设计两阶段对抗框架来识别评审洞见源自人类、LLM还是混合贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地参与科学写作和同行评审，仅判断"文本由谁写"已不够，还需判断"洞见由谁贡献"。现有检测方法在原始数据上表现好，但可能依赖语言和文本作者的捷径信号，在去偏评估下性能下降。

Method: 构建InsightProv-v0数据集，包含4,057篇科学论文和12,660条人工评审，用GPT-4o、Gemini、DeepSeek模拟不同LLM参与程度，并在句子级标注溯源。提出两阶段对抗框架，抑制捷径信号同时保留溯源相关信息。

Result: 强模型在原始数据上的高性能具有误导性，去偏评估后性能大幅下降。论文引用和相邻评审上下文提供互补的溯源信号；人类、混合和AI洞见在信息来源和失败模式上存在系统性差异。AI洞见多停留在通用或论文已有信息，人类洞见更常引入外部知识和独立判断。

Conclusion: 措辞可被LLM重写，但洞见的溯源留下更深、更持久的信号，为识别智力作者身份提供了新视角。

Abstract: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

</details>


### [148] [AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07426)
*Mu-Ruei Tseng,Waris Quamer,Ghady Nasrallah,Ricardo Gutierrez-Osuna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AccentCL：基于冻结Whisper-Large-v3与重放式持续学习的英语口音分类框架，兼具类别不平衡鲁棒性与跨语料域适应能力，支持增量添加新口音类别而无需全量重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统口音分类器标签集固定，无法随新数据纳入新口音类别；同时口音语料常存在显著类别不平衡，且不同语料录音条件差异导致域偏移，限制了模型的扩展性与泛化性。

Method: 从冻结的Whisper-Large-v3编码器提取多层表征；采用不平衡感知交叉熵损失降低对多数类的偏向，并用域均值对齐损失最小化跨训练语料的分布均值偏移；通过基于重放的持续学习扩展标签空间，利用冻结基模型保持知识，并以旧到新边界损失（old-to-new margin loss）抑制对新类别的过度预测。

Result: 五类口音分类任务上达到77.1%平衡准确率与76.9%宏平均F1。增量加入西班牙口音英语时，新类F1为83.3%，基类平衡准确率保持77.3%；继续加入中国口音英语时，新类F1为61.8%，已学类别平衡准确率保持77.6%。

Conclusion: AccentCL在类别不平衡与跨语料域偏移条件下实现了稳健的区域口音分类，并支持在不全量重训的前提下增量加入新口音类别，验证了该持续学习框架的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.

</details>


### [149] [Closing Ambient Clinical Documentation Gaps with Automated Provider Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07502)
*Joseph Paul Cohen,Raj Shah,Han-Chin Shing,Fang Wang,Susan Nguyen,Chaitanya Shivade,Jack Moriarty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM能否自动化临床文书中的查询循环（DAU：草拟-提问-更新），通过3000份真实病历审计与21k澄清轮次分析，揭示缺失文档来源并构建五个转录退化基准，发现有用问题预测因子具任务特异性，约9%的轮次反而损害性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床文档专家需向医生发送查询以填补临床记录空白，确保计费准确。现有工作假设转录完整，自动化草拟、ICD-10编码和医嘱提取，未处理这些文档缺失问题。

Method: 审计3000份真实就诊记录识别文档缺失来源，并基于公开数据构建五个转录退化基准；分析真实对话中的21k澄清轮次，研究有用问题的预测因子。

Result: 有用问题预测因子具任务特异性：oracle置信度占主导，但笔记完整性只需简单召回问题，ICD-10编码则需更难的多选项问题；约9%的轮次因冗余提问和非回答触发重写而损害性能。

Conclusion: 部署LLM查询循环不仅取决于学会"问什么"，更取决于学会"何时不问"。

Abstract: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.

</details>


### [150] [Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07519)
*Muhammad Rafiullah Memon,Viet Vo,Wanlun Ma,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用于评估"手语翻译(SLT)与面向儿童的平台安全审核机制"交界处的聋人知情部署前审计框架，含失败分类法、场景模式、四种对照条件与四项结果指标，计划以澳大利亚手语(Auslan)为首个案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动手语翻译已进入消费产品并被儿童使用，而面向儿童的人工智能与平台信任安全工具依据文本做决策（未成年人账户过滤、诱骗分类器）。手语儿童须经由翻译才能进入这些保护机制，但现有文献中未见两者被联合评估的系统，主流已部署SLT模型既未在18岁以下手语者上训练，也未做正式评估。翻译中若改变否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性或求助意图，可能在语言流利度不受影响的情况下改变安全判定，形成尚未被审查的风险边界。

Method: 提出一种聋人知情(deaf-informed)的部署前审计方法，针对SLT输出与平台安全审核的交界处。包含四部分：(1) 失败分类法，刻画翻译如何改变与安全相关的语义要素（否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性、求助）；(2) 经脱敏处理的场景模式(sanitised scenario schema)；(3) 四种对照条件用于比较；(4) 四项结果测量指标。计划以澳大利亚手语(Auslan)作为首个案例研究。

Result: 论文为研究提案类工作，报告的是文献审查发现与审计设计，而非实验数据：未发现任何公开记录的、对SLT与平台安全审核进行联合评估的系统；领先的已部署SLT模型未在18岁以下手语者上训练或正式评估。

Conclusion: SLT与儿童平台安全保障的交界处存在未被审查的评估空白，需在部署前进行聋人知情审计；所提出的分类法、场景模式、对照条件与指标为该审计提供可操作框架，Auslan将作为首个案例研究加以验证。

Abstract: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

</details>


### [151] [Quality-Aware Self-Correcting Speech Translation on an Edge Device](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07545)
*Zubair Ajmal Farooq,Diptesh Kanojia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可在Jetson Nano（4 GB）上全离线运行的语音到语音翻译流水线，利用多语言BERT余弦相似度作为质量估计（QE）门控触发二次修正，比较QE重排、MBR解码与约束束搜索三种修正方法，发现QE适合作为门控而非排序器，N=3候选池修正更精准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上实现无需重训练的离线语音翻译自我修正，解决低资源环境下翻译质量不足的问题，并探究质量估计（QE）在修正流程中的最优角色。

Method: Pipeline由Whisper-tiny ASR、Opus-MT翻译器与多语言BERT余弦相似度QE门控组成；当置信度低于阈值τ时触发二次修正。比较三种修正方法：QE重排（M1）、最小贝叶斯风险解码（M2）、约束束搜索（M3）。在FLORES-200英语-西班牙语1,012句上评测，并引入改编自后编辑工作量的增益-编辑比指标。

Result: M2在τ=0.90时相对贪婪解码取得显著提升：BLEU +0.67（p<0.001）、ChrF +0.51（p<0.001）、COMET +0.0020（N=3, p=0.002）；M1无显著增益；M3显著劣于基线（p>0.99）。移除QE模型进行候选选择（M1→M2）不损害质量，且从关键路径释放680 MB内存。N=3候选池修正更精准、语义充分性更好；N=10最大化词汇奖励。

Conclusion: QE更适合作为门控而非排序器；M2（MBR解码）在边缘设备上以较小候选池即可实现统计显著且更精准的修正；系统开源并支持六种语言对的实时翻译。

Abstract: We present a fully offline speech-to-speech translation pipeline that runs on a Jetson Nano (4 GB) and corrects its own weak translations without retraining. A Whisper-tiny ASR feeds an Opus-MT translator; multilingual BERT cosine similarity acts as a Quality Estimation (QE) gate, triggering a secondary-pass correction when confidence falls below a pre-defined threshold $τ$. We compare three correction methods: QE reranking (M1), Minimum Bayes-Risk decoding (M2), and constrained beam search (M3). On 1,012 FLORES-200 sentences (English-Spanish), M2 at $τ=0.90$ produces statistically significant improvements over greedy decoding on BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001), ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001), and COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002); M1 yields no significant gains, and M3 is significantly worse than baseline (p>0.99). Our central finding is that QE functions effectively as a gate but poorly as a ranker: removing the QE model from candidate selection (M1$\to$M2) does not hurt quality and frees 680 MB from the critical path. Using a gain-to-edit ratio adapted from the post-editing-effort literature, we further show that smaller candidate pools (N=3) yield more surgical corrections with better semantic adequacy, while larger pools (N=10) maximise lexical reward. We release the system and demonstrate live translation across six language pairs.

</details>


### [152] [HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07563)
*Jin Huang,Diego Ferreras Garrucho,Yutong Xie,Walter M. Yuan,Qiaozhu Mei,Chen Lian,Jonathon Hazell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HouseholdBench，整合6个美国家庭调查与32个预测任务（数值、类别、概率结果，覆盖消费、收入、劳动、预期与住房），评估13个LLM在家庭决策预测及政策响应上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经济学需要家庭决策的定量模型，LLM有潜力胜任；但现有评估覆盖调查和结果太少，且未研究家庭如何随经济条件变化而调整。

Method: 构建HouseholdBench：基于过去行为、人口统计与宏观经济条件，让LLM预测包括政策响应在内的家庭行为；与"无变化"基线和梯度提升树模型对比，评估13个闭源与开源权重LLM，并尝试微调与16次预测聚合等方法。

Result: 多数LLM优于无变化基线（含政策响应任务），最佳模型将数值结果误差降低12.2%；多数任务中梯度提升树排名第一，领先闭源LLM接近其表现，开源权重模型落后；LLM存在系统性高估与低估；微调加16次预测聚合可使40亿参数开源模型匹配闭源模型，且泛化到未参与微调的政策响应任务。

Conclusion: LLM已具备一定的家庭行为与政策响应预测能力，但传统树模型仍占优；通过微调与预测聚合可缩小开源与闭源模型差距，数据集、代码与榜单已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient-boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: https://jn-huang.github.io/householdbench

</details>


### [153] [Two Vectors Replace In-Context Demos: Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07572)
*Xi Ding,Naichen Shi,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出STAVE方法：用两个任务特定嵌入向量（readout向量与context向量）替代演示样例，以极低参数量和零样本推理成本实现任务自适应，在6个多模态模型和5个大语言模型上匹配或超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文学习(ICL)需在每次查询时重新编码演示样例，每个示例图像可增加数百个视觉token，开销巨大。现有的免演示(demo-free)方法虽用紧凑任务状态降低成本，但存在缺陷：任务参数在按任务搜索的位置或每个解码层中增加，导致参数量随深度增长；且插入的token或key无法改变原始提示在各层内的注意力分配方式。

Method: 提出STAVE(Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings)，用两个任务特定向量添加到已有输入嵌入中以替代演示样例：readout向量更新产生答案的token，context向量更新其他结构token组。两者均在含演示与不含演示的提示上用答案标签训练。作者通过损失的一阶分析和margin界从理论上论证了这些设计选择。

Result: 在6个大型多模态模型和5个大型语言模型上进行的大量实验表明，STAVE在多模态任务上以远少于现有方法的任务参数量匹配或超越SOTA方法，并在18个文本任务上超越15-shot ICL和先前的task vector方法，且推理成本为零样本级别。

Conclusion: STAVE通过结构化嵌入实现高效任务自适应，兼顾性能与参数效率，为免演示的LMM/LLM任务适配提供了新思路。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. To address these issues, we propose Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE), which replaces demos with two task-specific vectors added to existing input embeddings. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.

</details>


### [154] [Large Language Model Orchestration under Heterogeneous Preferences via Explicit Persona Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07587)
*Shuqing Shi,Ziyan Wang,Milind Tambe,Yali Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出HARP框架，将LLM编排中隐藏偏好信念从提示文本移出，改为对每个智能体维护数值后验并用贝叶斯闭式更新，LLM仅提供动作与候选似然；HARP+还加入区分性bonus，理论与实验均验证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编排需协调异构且偏好私密的自主智能体，核心难点是维护并更新对各智能体偏好的信念。现有LLM编排器仅将该信念作为提示文本携带，无显式更新规则，导致早期错误持续并传播、无法被纠正。

Method: 提出HARP框架：对每个智能体在一组有限候选偏好上维护一个数值后验，并用贝叶斯规则闭式更新；语言模型只负责提供动作和各候选的似然，从而将偏好估计与LLM推理解耦。进一步提出HARP+，在规划中加入对能区分候选的动作的bonus，使最优动作无信息时推断仍可继续。

Result: 理论上证明：当分解精确时，HARP达到与显式联合推断相同的Õ(√K)贝叶斯遗憾。实证在三种基座上（从偏好完全决定收益、收益依赖超出偏好的因素、到显式联合推断不可行的规模）表明HARP+是其所识别类别中最强的非预言机方法。

Conclusion: 将偏好信念从提示文本中剥离并以闭式贝叶斯后验维护，可在理论上保证贝叶斯遗憾不劣于显式联合推断，并在多种规模下实现最强的非预言机性能，为异构偏好智能体编排提供了可扩展且稳健的框架。

Abstract: LLM orchestration investigates how an orchestrator coordinates a group of autonomous agents to achieve common goals or maximize collective welfare. The agents are typically heterogeneous, each holding a private preference that it pursues but does not reveal. Inferring such hidden preferences from behavior has been a subject of long-standing research in game theory and multi-agent systems. The core challenge lies in maintaining a belief over every agent's preference and updating it from the agents' observed actions. Existing LLM orchestrators carry that belief as prompt text with no explicit update rule. This lets early errors persist and propagate rather than be corrected. We therefore propose \textbf{HARP} (Heterogeneous-preference Agent oRchestration via Preference inference), a novel framework that moves the belief out of the prompt. Specifically, HARP maintains one numeric posterior per agent over a finite set of candidate preferences and updates it in closed form by Bayes' rule. The language model supplies only actions and per-candidate likelihoods, so estimation is decoupled from its reasoning. We prove that HARP attains the same $\tilde O(\sqrt K)$ Bayesian regret as explicit joint inference when the factorization is exact. Furthermore, HARP\textsuperscript{+} augments planning with a bonus for actions that distinguish the candidates, so inference continues even when the optimal action is uninformative. Empirical results on three substrates, ranging from payoffs the preferences fully determine, through payoffs that depend on more than them, to scales where explicit joint inference is infeasible, demonstrate that HARP\textsuperscript{+} is the strongest non-oracle method across the class our theory identifies.

</details>


### [155] [Recurrent Looped Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07591)
*Yifan Zhang,Jichen Feng,Shihan Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出循环环状Transformer（RLT），将层分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器，使每token计算路径随序列长度增长而单token成本固定，在奇偶校验、置换跟踪和模运算等任务上显著超越标准Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态跟踪要求在每一步输入都进行更新，但标准Transformer对每个token施加的深度固定，与序列长度无关，导致难以泛化到更长序列。

Method: RLT将层划分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器；解码器在每个token处将编码器输出与上一token的最终解码器状态合并，实现计算路径随序列增长而单token成本固定。在六个算法任务上，用三种随机种子比较八层的五种划分方式与八层标准Transformer。

Result: 最多用40比特训练时，两种RLT划分将奇偶校验泛化到256比特且各随机种子均达100%准确率，而Transformer仅为随机水平；在8倍训练长度的swap-based S5置换跟踪上，RLT达97%最终状态准确率（Transformer<1%），且准确率随解码器深度增加；模运算外推中RLT达93%（Transformer为33%）。消融表明增益依赖反馈：移除反馈后各划分的奇偶校验与swap-based S5均降至随机水平；每四token块更新一次反馈可让块内已知token并行，64比特奇偶校验保持99%，但置换跟踪依赖逐token反馈，分块使长度64的swap-based S5从100%降至20%。

Conclusion: 逐token的循环反馈使RLT在序列长度外推上显著优于标准Transformer；反馈的频率对任务至关重要，奇偶校验可容忍分块反馈，而置换跟踪需要逐token反馈。

Abstract: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.

</details>


### [156] [Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07643)
*Ahsan Bilal,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Muhammad Umer,Wajih Hassan Raza,Atta Ul Asad,Young D. Kwon,Michal Valko,Dean F. Hougen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练、面向未来的KV缓存驱逐方法LORE-KV：通过采样短自回归续写估计查询轨迹，用响应侧查询状态评估提示词元效用，在LongBench与RULER上取得稳定提升，但存在额外时延与部分任务回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV-cache驱逐方法多基于"阅读提示时哪些记忆显得重要"来评估，而真正应回答的是"生成答案时哪些记忆会起作用"。由于驱逐时解码查询不可得，已有未来感知方法依赖伪响应或合成未来查询估计，存在偏差且往往需要辅助模型或训练。

Method: 将固定预算的未来感知驱逐建模为对模型条件化查询轨迹的分布估计；LORE-KV从冻结的目标模型采样短自回归续写，取其响应侧查询状态估计提示词元效用；词元得分采用投影的留一注意力输出删除代价（projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost），并在多次采样未来上聚合，可选按轨迹加权；临时续写在最终解码前丢弃，无需辅助模型或训练。

Result: B=128时，单条响应侧续写即恢复约89%相对提示窗口对照的增益，增加未来样本收益递减。B=128时Qwen2.5-14B的LongBench平均分由45.49升至48.24（+2.75）；Mistral-7B的16K RULER平均分由45.20升至51.05（+5.85）。缓存预算增大后增益减弱，并伴随任务级回退。一次性压缩开销为AnDPro单样本墙钟时间的1.46–2.77倍，覆盖六种稠密与混合注意力骨干。

Conclusion: 未来感知的KV驱逐可被视为查询轨迹上的分布估计问题，单次响应侧续写即可获得主要收益；LORE-KV免训练、无需辅助模型即可提升长上下文表现，但收益随预算增大而衰减，且存在任务级回退与时延开销，需在效率与效果间权衡。

Abstract: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.

</details>


### [157] [DLoop: Looped Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07659)
*Geonmo Gu,Byeongho Heo,HeeJae Jun,Yoohoon Kang,Sangmin Lee,Sangdoo Yun,Dongyoon Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DLoop，一种循环式投机解码方法，可在一次验证前自适应地进行多轮草稿生成，从而减少目标模型前向次数并将墙钟加速提高 5%~41%，且保持无损解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投机解码在每一轮草稿后都必然进行一次目标模型验证。随着草稿模型能力增强，目标模型常常接受整轮草稿的全部 token，此时紧随其后的验证造成不必要的目标模型前向计算。自适应草稿长度方法虽可减少验证频率，但仅对自回归草稿模型有效；对并行草稿模型而言，继续草稿需要尚未验证草稿 token 对应的目标模型隐状态，无法直接继续。

Method: DLoop 采用循环式投机解码：在草稿模型保持高置信度时，自适应地连续执行多个草稿阶段，并将累积的草稿 token 一次性提交目标模型验证，用额外草稿模型前向换取更少的目标模型前向。为保证草稿模型在额外阶段仍可靠，提出 loop-aware training，让草稿模型在训练时接触针对未验证草稿 token 的自身隐状态。

Result: 在 EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark 以及多 token 预测模块等多种投机解码方法上，DLoop 将墙钟加速提升 5% 至 41%，同时保持无损解码。

Conclusion: DLoop 通过自适应多轮草稿与循环感知训练，有效降低目标模型验证前向开销，在多种主流投机解码框架上取得一致的端到端加速且不损失输出质量，代码将开源。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

</details>


### [158] [Detecting LLM-Assisted Vietnamese Writing via Keystrokes under Behavioral Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07700)
*Thanh Dong,An Ngo,Minh Dau,Rajesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究击键动力学在检测LLM辅助写作中的鲁棒性。作者构建了越南语击键数据集，涵盖真实写作、转录与改写模式，并定义行为层面的威胁模型，生成对抗性变体数据。实验比较时序/节奏特征方法与1D-CNN、TypeNet序列模型，结果显示序列模型多数情况更优，但转录可稳定识别，改写与对抗样本常被误判；引入对抗训练后可显著提升分离度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有击键动力学检测LLM辅助写作的研究多局限于特征方法，且缺乏对真实多元写作行为及用户刻意规避行为的考量。作者希望验证击键信号是否真正编码写作过程信息，并评估其在现实与对抗场景下的鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 构建越南语击键数据集，覆盖真实写作、转录、改写三类写作模式；2) 定义行为层面的威胁模型，其中用户刻意改变打字模式，并据此生成行为操纵的对抗变体数据；3) 采用四类建模方法：时序表示、节奏表示，以及1D-CNN与TypeNet序列建模；4) 在用户无关与上下文无关两种设定下评测；5) 引入基于行为操纵数据的对抗训练。

Result: 序列模型在大多数情况下优于基于特征的方法，表明击键信号能编码关于写作过程的判别性信息。但检测并非普遍鲁棒：转录可被可靠识别，而改写样本与对抗操纵样本在未显式建模时经常被误判为真实写作。加入基于行为操纵数据的对抗训练后，样本可分性与鲁棒性显著提升。

Conclusion: 击键检测性能关键取决于模型是否接触过多样化的写作行为；在有限条件下取得的高性能若缺乏针对性建模，无法泛化到真实或对抗场景。未来需将多样化行为与对抗建模纳入击键检测框架。

Abstract: We study the robustness of keystroke dynamics for detecting large language model (LLM)-assisted writing. We introduce a Vietnamese keystroke dataset capturing realistic writing modes, including bona fide composition, transcription, and paraphrasing. We also define a behaviorally grounded threat model in which users deliberately alter typing patterns. To implement the threat model, we create behaviorally manipulated variants of the data designed to evade keystroke-based detection. We evaluate four keystroke modeling approaches: temporal and rhythmic representations, and sequential representations modeled with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and TypeNet, under user-independent and context-independent settings. The results show that sequential models outperform feature-based approaches in most cases and that keystroke signals encode discriminative information about the writing process. However, detection is not uniformly robust: transcription is reliably identified, while paraphrasing and adversarially manipulated samples are frequently misclassified as bona fide when not explicitly modeled. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training using behaviorally manipulated data, which substantially improves separability and robustness. These results suggest that keystroke-based detection depends critically on exposure to diverse writing behaviors, and that strong performance under limited conditions does not generalize to realistic or adversarial settings without targeted modeling.

</details>


### [159] [Readout Stability in Prefill-Only Decision Models:Zero-Label Prediction and Inference-Time Compute Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07716)
*Ran Li,Lei Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了仅预填充（prefill-only）决策模型的一个可检验特性：当干预只改变候选菜单而输入文本不变时，干预后的准确率可由首轮缓存分布决定；基于该特性提出的无标签、单次前向的估计器在7个模型族、10个数据集上预测误差在4.2点内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅预填充决策模型（如受Jev模型启发）在一次前向中为菜单中所有候选打分且不进行解码，调用成本比同规模生成式语言模型低一到两个数量级。作者希望探究这种读出结构是否带有可利用的可检验性质，从而将推理时计算转化为部署前即可完成的决策。

Method: 提出估计器：当干预仅改变候选菜单、输入文本不变时，将第一轮（pass-1）概率限制到菜单上、重新归一化并取argmax，无需标签、无需第二次前向。并在7个模型族、10个数据集、2类任务上验证；另设概率级变体作为对照，并对同规模生成式语言模型做对比实验。此外比较均匀额外前向、置信度级联、菜单策展与增大模型等方案。

Result: 菜单干预预测误差在4.2点内，其中一个模型族预测完全精确；概率级变体误差达21.0点，说明该特性存在于排序而非概率中，且不能通过校准恢复。同规模生成式语言模型不具备该特性，估计误差为1.6–15.8点且随模型增大而恶化。均匀额外前向仅改善校准几乎不提升准确率；在同等成本下置信度级联优于任何重复询问同一模型的方案；菜单策展优于增大模型，0.8B模型在策展的5候选菜单上于CLINC150达95.4%，而4B模型在全150标签菜单上为80.0%。

Conclusion: 仅预填充决策模型的读出结构具有可检验且可预测的性质，使推理时计算可在部署前决定；该性质依赖于排序而非概率，且为生成式语言模型所不具备。菜单策展与置信度级联比增大模型更高效，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Prefill-only decision models inspired by the Jev model score every candidate in a menu during a single forward pass and never decode, which makes one call one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than a same-scale generative language model. We show that this read-out structure comes with a testable property. When an intervention changes only the candidate menu and leaves the input text fixed, the post-intervention accuracy is already determined by the cached first-pass distribution. The estimator restricts the pass-1 probabilities to the menu, renormalizes, and reads off the argmax; it uses no labels and no second forward pass. Across seven model families, ten datasets and two task types, menu-only interventions are predicted to within 4.2 points, and for one family the prediction is exact. A probability-level variant of the same estimator errs by 21.0 points, so the property lives in the ranking rather than in the probabilities and is not recovered by calibration. Same-scale generative language models do not share the property. On those models the same estimator errs by 1.6 to 15.8 points and degrades as the model grows. The property turns inference-time compute into a decision that can be made before deployment. Uniform extra passes buy calibration but almost no accuracy; at matched cost a confidence cascade outperforms every scheme that re-asks the same model, and curating the menu beats enlarging the model, with a 0.8B model on a curated 5-candidate menu reaching 95.4% on CLINC150 against 80.0% for a 4B model on the full 150-label menu.Code and data are available at https://github.com/rlisml/jev-cascade.

</details>


### [160] [Does Steering Break Your Model? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Suite for LLM Steering Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07722)
*Haotian Yang,Huikang Jiang,Yucheng Wu,Wen-Jie Jiang,Chenpeng Wang,Yibin Lou,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出 SteerScope——一个双轴、多维度（15 项指标）的激活引导（activation steering）评测套件，联合刻画引导效果与方法属性。在匹配模型、任务与评测协议下对 4 个家族共 23 种方法进行基准测试，发现现有激活引导方法在效果与副作用的整体权衡上尚未超越 Prompt Steering 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对激活引导的评测仅零散覆盖"目标行为有效性""非预期变化限制""跨输入与训练数据鲁棒性"等维度，未系统刻画效果与副作用之间的权衡关系，因而缺乏统一、可扩展的评测基准。

Method: 提出 SteerScope：双轴、多维度评测套件，含 15 项指标。轴一为引导结果，在语言质量、任务能力、安全与可靠性上分别评分目标效果与副作用；轴二为方法属性，通过引导特化指标评估泛化性与数据依赖性（样本效率、样本敏感性）。不局限于单一操作点，而是刻画效果—副作用权衡曲线。在匹配模型、任务与评测协议下，基准测试涵盖 prompting、LoRA、SFT 基线在内的 4 个家族共 23 种方法，并以可扩展代码库形式发布。

Result: 1）在两个模型规模上，没有任何被测激活引导方法能在不引入更高综合副作用的前提下取得更高效果，整体权衡未超过 Prompt Steering 基线；2）发现引导效果与副作用之间存在一致性耦合；3）在 OOD 提示下，目标效果常得以保持，但副作用更明显，尤其表现为指令相关性与流畅度下降；4）各方法的样本效率画像差异显著。
